title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on How to Understand "Misappropriating Funds of the Unit for Personal Use or Lending to Others" as Provided in Article 272 of the Criminal Law

articles.content_en:
Fashi [2000] No. 22
Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:
We have received your court's Xin Gao Fa [1998] No. 193 Request for Instructions on How to Understand the Provision of Article 272 of the Criminal Law 'Misappropriating Funds of the Unit for Personal Use or Lending Them to Others'. Upon study, we reply as follows:
Where a person who is not a state functionary of a company, enterprise, or other unit, taking advantage of his position, misappropriates funds of the unit for his own use or for use by other natural persons, or where the misappropriator, in his own name, lends the misappropriated funds to other natural persons or units, if the conduct constitutes a crime, he shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Article 272, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law.
This is our reply.
